column1: # tests/scope-core.tsv — the ALWAYS-RUN CORE for diff-scoped suite selection (HERD-585,
# Every name below is UNIONED into EVERY scoped selection, no matter which file a diff touched —
# these are the cross-cutting whole-tree guards a diff to ANY file can trip: the capability/config
# manifests, the shared gate lints, the conformance ledger, and the suite's own hermeticity and
# Format: one bare tests/test-*.sh basename per line. Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored. A
# name that is not (or no longer) in the curated set — retired, renamed, newly exempted — is dropped
# silently by the intersection in herd_suite_tests_for_diff, and asserted present here by
# tests/test-suite-scope.sh, so a rename is caught by the proof rather than silently shrinking the
# INCIDENT (HERD-585): PR #708 shipped a ghost config key because the diff-scoped selection paired
# scripts/herd/journal-audit.sh only with its own test — tests/test-config-manifest.sh, the manifest's
# own ghost/dead-key scan, never ran. test-config-manifest.sh is the row this file exists to make
# impossible to drop again; the rest of the cross-cutting lint runners ride along with it because the
# same escape shape applies to every one of them. tests/test-suite-scope.sh hardcodes this exact
# required set INDEPENDENTLY of this file's contents, so a row dropped here (by accident or by a
# future edit) reds the mutation-prove instead of silently shrinking the core.
